fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that Anitha Raj, aged 49, could not be traced after leaving home for college; the last sighting was near Amudham Layout Residential Colony. The matter was brought to Salem East PS on 2025-07-16, while the incident was placed on 2025-07-15 at about 08:00. The complaint was lodged by Arun Prakash (9000000194), a family member of Anitha Raj, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000399. Harish Mani (9000000132) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. A car bearing the number TN-30-YY-1079 was seen leaving the area. The family mentioned that Gokul Sundaram (9000000491) was last known to be in contact with the missing person. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Mobile phone reportedly switched off after the last known call.
